verdict.rationale: MailerSend's first-party API docs describe webhooks that subscribe to real-time event notifications. Delivery is to registered URLs, with a reachability test request on create or update and automatic exponential-backoff retries for about 3 days. That covers registrable outbound HTTP callbacks a programmatic consumer can receive. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration, and the pack does not enumerate event types or document signature verification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks allow you to subscribe to real-time notifications about various events that occur in MailerSend.
If your endpoint is unreachable or returns a non-2xx response, MailerSend automatically retries with exponential backoff for up to about 3 days.
When creating or updating a webhook, MailerSend will send a test request to the provided URL to verify that it is reachable.
